cases.question: Does selecting the same dirty file preserve my edits?
cases.requiredResponse: It still opens Discard unsaved changes? Cancel retains the editor; Discard and open clears the buffer/history before a file read. Read failure may leave an empty editor; there is no persistent stash.

cases.question: Does switching checkout save my dirty file?
cases.requiredResponse: No. A different checkout prompts while dirty; Discard and switch clears owned editor state without save/commit/remote operation. Selecting the current checkout returns without a dialog.
cases.requiredCitation: axiom.help.repositories.editor-nested-controls revision 1 only after genuine approval and exact applicable version/source validation; otherwise disclose approved applicable evidence unavailable

cases.question: Can Cancel or switching prove my timed-out Save stopped?
cases.requiredResponse: No. Dismissing a pending confirmation prevents its callback only. Submitted native work is not cancelled; inspect current disk content before retrying an uncertain Save.
cases.requiredCitation: axiom.help.repositories.editor-nested-controls revision 1 only after genuine approval and exact applicable version/source validation; otherwise disclose approved applicable evidence unavailable

cases.question: Does Prepare Agent draft send code or replace existing input?
cases.requiredResponse: No. It appends an unsent ordinary-code prompt to existing input with a blank line and selects Inspect / Code Review chat mode. Review all composer text before separate Send; it does not save or execute code.
cases.requiredCitation: axiom.help.repositories.editor-nested-controls revision 1 only after genuine approval and exact applicable version/source validation; otherwise disclose approved applicable evidence unavailable

cases.question: Does the preparation dialog preview my selection, and can I move selection to change it?
cases.requiredResponse: The code-selection dialog has descriptive text but no excerpt preview. It captures the excerpt and full buffer; moving selection alone does not replace it. Cancel and reselect. Changed file/buffer or busy operation rejects preparation; obsolete ownership may suppress it.

cases.question: Does Next diff page approve changes or cancel a pending save?
cases.requiredResponse: No. It changes display state only. Pagination applies above 2,000 rendered diff rows including context/omission markers, resets on before/after change, and neither proves review nor gates Save. It has no pagination Cancel.
